about: Robinhood Chain MAINNET (4663). NOT READY TO DEPLOY: the script refuses this file while the word T-O-D-O appears anywhere in it, and it appears beside every value a person has not confirmed. Confirmed by a person (Thom, 2026-10-12): timelock.owner, the Safe, and the guardian. Not confirmed: every asset's pool, every asset's ceiling (maxWeightBps), and the eight tokens added on 2026-10-12. The first mainnet step is owner-signed vaults only: no keeper (keeperEnabled false, keeper zero, every asset's flags 0), so no averageFeed is needed yet; the pool-average feed fills that slot when the keeper comes. The admin and the beacon's owner is a TimelockController the script creates; timelock.owner is the Safe that proposes to it. Listed: USDG as cash and nine tokens (NVDA, SPY, AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA, GLD), each with its Chainlink feed and its feedDescription, and each with `pool`: the one hookless Uniswap v4 pool against USDG its trades go through (fee in hundredths of a basis point, tick spacing). The deploy script does not read `pool` (the contracts hold no pool); the app's builder and the guard do, and test/fork/RobinhoodForkDeploy.t.sol trades every listed token through it on a fork. All read at block 86735800 on 2026-10-12 by packages/chain-evm/test/pool-quotes.ts (ROBINHOOD-MAINNET-SCOPE, section of that day). Not listed: QQQ and SGOV, whose v4 pools against USDG do not fill a $1,000 trade. No deposit cap is set (caps none; Thom, 2026-10-10): the per-vault and total caps exist in the contracts and the Safe can set them later through the timelock. Closed days are the NYSE closures the test network file carries. safeMinThreshold is the fewest signatures the Safe must need (2 at least on a mainnet). Anyone may create a vault; naming creators would restrict it to them.

timelock.ownerNote: The Safe Thom created on Robinhood Chain on 2026-10-12 (block 86,734,497). Read on chain that day: Safe 1.5.0, threshold 2, owners 0x0a1c3312c808b23D019bF241028f6B5624f4cc98 (Thom Gabriel) and 0xAC3cBBCd6e51dBFAf4e79d5E8Cf54a1622D71e0e (Rodrigo Trindade), no module enabled, no guard, nonce 0. Recorded in docs/vault/SECURITY.md. With two owners and a threshold of two, one lost key locks it.

guardianNote: Thom Gabriel's address, confirmed by Thom on 2026-10-12. It can only pause. It is also one of the Safe's two owners, by his decision (docs/vault/SECURITY.md). Never the deployer, never the keeper's machine.
